subject: Request: Leadership sign-off for 30% Hosted API discount - NimbleHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing proposal — NimbleHealth

Hi team,

Following up from last week's demo: NimbleHealth (Olivia) is asking for a firm price to support an 18-month committed usage for Hosted API. Their proposed commitment is ~18M tokens/month average, ramping from 8M to 25M over 3 quarters.

They've asked whether we can do a 30% list discount off our standard Hosted API rate in exchange for the 18-month term and a SKU-level commit. I pushed back to 20% initially, but they flagged procurement timelines and competitive pressure (two other vendors on the table).

I've attached the Mutual Action Plan and an initial forecast. Key asks:
- Approve up to 30% discount on Hosted API usage pricing (one rate for entire term)
- Commit to a 180-day SLA review and add a one-time onboarding credit if approved

Why I recommend approving:
- High committed volume materially improves unit economics; 18-month term reduces churn risk
- NimbleHealth is a product-led customer with a fast integration schedule; reference potential in healthcare vertical

If we can't meet 30% they'll likely push to alternate vendors and delay procurement 6+ weeks.

Attachments: NimbleHealth_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf

Next step: Need deal desk and leadership guidance on approval path for >20% discounts.

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa,

Thanks for the background and the MAP. A 30% list discount is outside of the Deal Desk delegated authority — anything >20% requires senior leadership sign-off and finance sign-off.

Before we escalate, please provide the following so I can package the request succinctly:
- 18-month committed token schedule (monthly granularity)
- Expected ARR at our list and at proposed 30% net price
- Estimated gross margin / contribution after infra cost for Hosted API (back-of-envelope)
- Any required contract concessions (data residency, custom SLA, IP language)

I created a quick deal summary that I want filled in; see attachment: deal_summary_ND-4589.xlsx. Once we have those numbers I'll prepare a one-pager for leadership.

Rishi / David —

Escalating for leadership sign-off. Summary for quick review (one-pager attached):
- Customer: NimbleHealth (Olivia Chen)
- Ask: 30% discount on Hosted API usage for 18-month committed contract
- Commitment: ~18M tokens/month avg (ramp to 25M) => estimated $1.2M ARR at proposed net pricing
- Trade-offs: 30% reduces list-based unit economics but commitment reduces churn; request includes a recommendation to add a one-time onboarding fee of $35k to offset initial ramp and to preserve margin.
- Contract asks: Standard T&Cs; procurement may request limited SLAs (will share redlines).
- Time pressure: Procurement deadline June 10 — we need sign-off by EOD 5/28 to make contracting window.

Recommendation: Approve 30% discount conditional on:
1) Execution of 18-month SKU-level commitment
2) $35k onboarding fee or equivalent ARR-side make-whole
3) No additional data residency concessions beyond our standard Hosted API language

Attachments: approval_onepager_Nimble.pdf

If approved, Marissa will issue an updated quote and Jonas will prepare the contract with the conditional terms.

Thanks,
